findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_patient_portal, get_emr_evidence · Private data: search_providers, get_state_records_law, get_patient_portal, get_breach_incidents, get_emr_vendor, get_pricing, find_emr_options, compare_emr_options, get_emr_evidence · Public sink: get_patient_portal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_patient_portal, get_emr_evidence · Private data: search_providers, get_state_records_law, get_patient_portal, get_breach_incidents, get_emr_vendor, get_pricing, find_emr_options, compare_emr_options, get_emr_evidence · Public sink: get_patient_portal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_state_records_law" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
